# Repository Custom Instructions for GitHub Copilot

> **Note**: This is a template file distributed by the Enterprise Copilot Prompts extension. Customize this content for your enterprise.

## Project Context

This repository uses enterprise-standard GitHub Copilot customization files distributed via the Enterprise Copilot Prompts extension.

## Available Resources

### Prompt Files (`.github/prompts/`)

Invoke prompts in VS Code by typing `@workspace /prompts` and selecting the desired prompt.

- `example-prompt.prompt.md` - Example prompt template

### Agent Profiles (`.github/agents/`)

Custom agent profiles that can be invoked by the Copilot coding agent.

- `example-agent.agent.md` - Example agent template

### Agent Instructions (`AGENTS.md`)

- Root `AGENTS.md` - Repository-wide agent guidance
- `src/AGENTS.md` - Source code-specific guidance

## Enterprise Guidelines

Replace this section with your enterprise-specific:

- Coding standards references
- Security policies
- Compliance requirements
- Internal tool documentation links
- Contact information for support

## Customization

This file and all template files can be customized by your team. The extension provides a starting structure that follows GitHub Copilot best practices.
